factors: Nine claims distinguish procedural advice from subjective aesthetic ratings
Nine separately grounded source-map points and creator Cook primary documentation
Three Reader and one separately labeled SharePlane Work editorial comparisons
complexity.rationale: The creator's workflow combines subjective design judgment, agent implementation claims and unreplicated resource figures, requiring extended source and limitations review.

sourceMap.rationale: The presenter introduces reference gathering and contrasts design targets with short prompts; automatic caption cue checked, not replicated design output.
The presenter recommends mockup and target definition before full implementation; claimed savings are not measured.
The numerical quality-target chapter starts at 04:58, while creator Cook documentation labels the extreme bar aspirational.
The approximately 66% self-assessment occurs in automatic VTT around 06:18–06:20, separately from the earlier numerical-target introduction.
The presenter discusses giving iterative construction enough time; no controlled cost-to-quality result is shown.
The presenter criticizes recurring generic visual patterns while aesthetic criteria remain subjective.
Incremental component and motion construction is recommended without comparative productivity evidence.
Fresh-context critics are proposed but not proven statistically independent or reproducible.
Cook's repeatable build, critique and revision loop is checked against its public README, SKILL and rubric; outcome claims are not independently replicated.

sourceCoverage.rationale: Nine distinct source-map cues were checked against the hash-matched automatic VTT and creator primary documents; no listening certification claimed.

supportingArgument.rationale: The source supports reference-driven design, mockups, iteration and critique as a documented process rather than a guaranteed aesthetic result.

evidenceRoles.rationale: Creator demonstration, public Cook specification, subjective score and reviewer-proposed tests are distinguished from independent measurements.

counterargument.rationale: Aspirational 99.9% target, subjective 66% self-rating and noncalibrated critics challenge claims of objectively superior design.

tradeoffs.rationale: Reference quality and iterative review can improve discipline but consume tokens, time and reviewer attention without guaranteed acceptance.

falsifiability.rationale: Repeatable matched visual briefs with blinded human acceptance, accessibility checks, cost and time could test outcomes; no such experiment was performed.

originalSynthesis.rationale: The productive intervention is a visible target and sustained feedback loop, not a longer prompt or an aesthetic score treated as a test oracle.

performance.rationale: Creator-reported build duration and output-token figures are contextual examples, not benchmarked agent speed or measured design gain.

economics.rationale: Iteration cost should be normalized to accepted results and review effort; no reproducible pricing, savings or ROI is inferred.

threatGovernance.rationale: Human acceptance, evidence provenance and distinct critic roles are preserved; the public article exposes no retained media, secrets or private paths.

ownerDecision.approval: Tony accepted the Reader #56 draft and preview in the conversation and subsequently approved advancing the review. The later bounded corrections fix timestamp attribution, date labeling and claim-count precision without rewriting the accepted thesis. This declaration records editorial acceptance only, not an exact-head GitHub-authenticated marker or unconditional production merge authorization.

gaps.rationale: Automatic captions were not independently listening-certified; the video rendering and claimed Cook design outcomes were not reproduced.
Three Reader and one SharePlane Work connections are editorial comparisons, not source corroboration; the external Work retains a migration-status caveat.
The independent editorial reviewer did not certify native iPhone, full accessibility compliance, Netlify artifact byte binding or production release.

decisionRationale: A separate, attributable reviewer initially held publication for four precise source and metadata defects, then accepted the corrected exact head 8aefe1fdf5b4a8ddbdfd39dbfed95d953ecd2479. Nine claim and source-map points now distinguish target from self-assessment and retain limitations; the prior owner draft acceptance remains editorial, while exact-head merge authorization is a later release gate.
